title: Grid Tactics action frame (agent -> server, inbound)
description: One action-set submitted per tick: at most one action per controlled unit. A unit not listed Holds (the default). Encoded from docs/design/grid-tactics-v1.md §4. Must echo the observation's turn_id AND nonce (anti-replay). additionalProperties is false everywhere: unknown fields are a schema_invalid reject. Costs are canonical server-side (hold 0, move 1/step, attack 2) and are NOT declared by the client — this deliberately drops the legacy client-declared `cost` echo (see versioning.md).

dir.description: Orthogonal step direction. N=+y, E=+x, S=-y, W=-x.

steps.description: Ordered step list (NOT a destination), 1..unit.speed entries. Validated left-to-right from the current cell; the first step leaving the board or entering an obstacle truncates the move (the unit takes the legal prefix). Zero-length/empty is illegal — use `hold`.

target.description: Target CELL (not a unit) within the unit's attack range (Chebyshev) of its current cell, and on-board. You fire where you predict the enemy will be; movement resolves before combat, so a vacated target is a whiff. Because vision >= range, the target is always a cell you can see.

turn_id.description: MUST equal the current observation's turn_id (= tick). A stale/future turn_id is rejected (`stale_turn`).

nonce.description: MUST equal the current observation's nonce. Mismatch or reuse -> `bad_echo` reject.

units.description: 0..4 unit actions. At most one action per unit_id; a duplicate unit_id in one set is schema_invalid. A unit omitted here Holds. An empty array means every unit Holds (a legal no-op).

thought.description: OPTIONAL spectator commentary (<=200 chars, <=1/tick). NEVER parsed by the engine, never delivered to the opponent in-match, sanitized before storage, shown to spectators on a >=3-tick delay. Can also be sent out-of-band via the standalone `thought` frame.

examples.thought: Falling the Lancer back to screen the Nexus.
